rawFindings.title: Removal of automatic versioning field addition in Model.compile
rawFindings.explanation: The removed code in lib/model.js disables automatic addition of the versioning key to schemas without an explicit versionKey path. This breaks the expected behavior where versioning (__v) is added only to root schemas and not to embedded schemas, potentially causing issues in tracking document revisions.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the removed code in Model.compile that checks for versioningEnabled and adds the versionKey field to the schema if missing, ensuring versioning is applied only to the top-level document.

rawFindings.title: Versioning no longer conditionally added to schemas in Schema constructor
rawFindings.explanation: The code was modified to remove any direct addition of versioning to the schema within the schema constructor. Without revising how versioning is handled, this may cause versioning not to be added automatically to any schemas, conflicting with mongoose's expected versioning behavior.
rawFindings.suggestion: Add appropriate logic in the Schema constructor or elsewhere to ensure versioning fields are properly added to top-level schemas only, consistent with previous behavior.
